title_en: Apple's 2nd Generation AirTags Drop to a New Price Low, a Practical Accessory for Forgetful iPhone Owners
summary_en: A practical accessory for iPhone owners who tend to lose wallets, keys, remotes.
body_en:
Apple's infinitely versatile AirTag just dropped to the lowest price I've seen. Amazon currently has the four-pack of Apple AirTags Gen 2 keyfinders for just $79.99 shipped, or just $20 per AirTag. The Apple Airtags is a practical accessory for iPhone owners who tend to lose small wearables like wallets, keys, cats, or remotes.
The Apple Airtag is a small coin-shaped device that you can put in your wallet or attach to your phones, keys, remote, or anything small enough to be easily misplaced. It works as a little Wi-Fi keyfinder that helps locate your lost objects by pinging its general location to your iPhone using Bluetooth 5.0. However, if your iPhone model has a U1 chip with Ultra Wideband, then you can take advantage of the "Precision Finding" mode. This gives you numerical distance and direction guidance when your lost item is close by. It points you right to it.
The second generation model is an iterative upgrade over its predecessor. It features more powerful Precision Finding, longer Bluetooth range, and a louder speaker. Fortunately the CR2032 coin battery is still user-replaceable, so your AirTag won't end up in a landfill when the battery depletes, nor will you have to deal with battery degradation like you would with a non-replaceable lithium battery.
Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
